svg.text: Four seeded chains per arm, 1,000 retained +200 discarded each. Fixed settings, not a tuned sampler ranking.
Shared Gaussian scatter axes [-4,4] for both coordinates. Mixture has separate time/x axes; no density fit or hidden thinning.
R-hat is classical unsplit/unranked, not a convergence certificate. Equal transitions cost different target work; no speed claim.
Exact truths are analytic. Good pooled moments can coexist with zero within-chain mode exploration.
